title: Peninsula Hot Springs, Sound Healing Sessions
summary: Monthly sound healing immersion at Peninsula Hot Springs through autumn and winter. Thermal bathing paired with a guided sound session. Adults, bookings essential.
priceRange: Bathing session + event ticket (see PHS website)
accessibilityNotes: Accessible thermal pools; check specific needs with venue
suggestedItineraryPairing: Full day hot springs experience; combine with Sunday Sessions or Bathe-in Cinema
editorVerdict: Peninsula Hot Springs sound healing isn't a gimmick, it's a genuine 90-minute reset, and the venue is the right one for it.
editorNote:
Monthly sound bath sessions at Peninsula Hot Springs through autumn and winter, run alongside thermal bathing. The combination is the point: warm water first, sound second, the rest of the day looking different.

Book well ahead, sessions are small and PHS regulars treat the calendar like a release schedule. The exact dates need checking month by month on the events page, the rhythm is roughly monthly through May to September.

Go on a wet weekday if you can. The bathhouse is at its best when the crowd is thin and the steam is rising off the cold pools.
